title: Mixing: Wide Prairie, I Got Up by Linda McCartney | 1973
content:
Studio Four, EMI Pathé Marconi Studios, Paris
Producers: Linda McCartney, Paul McCartney

Wings had recorded two songs by Linda McCartney in two sessions in Paris on 21 November 1973. The following day they were mixed in stereo.

The songs were ‘Wide Prairie’ and ‘I Got Up’, which were being considered for a Linda McCartney solo project.

Paul McCartney mixed both songs, and they returned to England with five tape reels from the sessions.

Also during the Parisian sessions, Paul recorded a jingle for Radio Luxembourg. Known as ‘Luxy’, it contained the titled of various Band On The Run songs, and was intended to promote the album.

Wings remained in Paris for two more days, staying at the George V hotel. They left Cherbourg on the 9pm ferry on Saturday 24 November.

Page last updated: 16 December 2025
